title: Second iteration: clear documented affinity and thematic 2023 programmes
authority: Direct owner feedback in this chat on 2026-10-12, including missing positions as zero contribution, automatic all-candidacy inclusion, thematic programme comparison and edition-labelled navigation. The owner additionally requested deliberate UI/UX click flows, contextual side panels, mobile reading views and the same interaction care for topical programme comparison.
summary: Plan the next local iteration around ordered horizontal affinity bars, a contextual programme reader and deliberate proposal/source exploration. Keep twenty balanced starters and ten-question extensions, the zero-contribution shared denominator and automatic inclusion of every candidacy. Add a public thematic comparison journey and an optional focused reading workspace. This is the historical 2023 edition; application implementation remains pending.

sections.title: Second iteration scope
sections.lead: A result that can be understood at a glance, with evidence available through a separate proposal journey.
items: Owner requests recorded on 12 October 2026 authorize this planning increment. This file is an implementation-ready proposal; no second-iteration application change is complete.

The accepted owner changes replace 10 + 5 with 20 + 10, include all candidacies without a chooser, treat missing party positions as zero documented contribution within the common denominator, and add a thematic programme page.
Keep the first iteration, its signed/unsigned history, 2023 source notebooks, public pointer and local acceptance records intact. Q001-Q030 retain their actual first-iteration statuses.

Present the product as Cuestionario 2023. Publication state and internal validation state are separate metadata; do not present the quiz as a public draft or confuse local completion with a deployed release.

The future Cuestionario 2026 is a separate menu entry once its own evidence-backed edition exists. Do not publish a dead link, reuse 2023 positions, or treat current surveys as 2026 programme evidence.
Metrics and optional translations remain deferred and disabled. No accounts, new dependencies, purchases, push, deployment or scheduler is part of this plan.

sections.title: Documented affinity on a shared denominator
sections.lead: An absent position contributes zero matching evidence; it is never encoded as a neutral party stance.
items: Use similarity 1 - abs(answer - position) / 4 only for a directly authored numeric party position. Unknown, conflicting, missing-programme and unverified cells contribute 0 to the numerator and retain their weight in the denominator.

Use ten fixed positive topic budgets. Within each topic, distribute its budget over the numeric answers actually supplied, with equal policy-family budgets and equal weights inside a family. The same answer universe, topic weights and denominator apply to every candidacy/profile before sorting.

Topic contribution = sum(weight * documented similarity) / sum(weight of the numeric answers in that topic). Overall affinity = 100 * sum(topic budget * topic contribution) / sum(all topic budgets). A missing programme can therefore have 0% documented affinity without any inferred political disagreement.

The complete aggregate requires at least one numeric answer in every active topic. If all questions in a topic are skipped/unsure, leave the overall percentage pending and offer a clear path to review that topic; show available proposal/topic detail without fabricating the user stance. Do not silently treat user uncertainty as a negative answer or a zero party contribution.

Every topic starts enabled with weight 1. Optional importance, if retained after the simple entry flow, uses Normal / Me importa especialmente (1 / 2); no topic-zero setting may remove a theme. Importance changes the shared denominator for all parties, including zero contributions for missing important positions.

Coverage = weighted share with a documented party position. Evidence coverage is distinct from affinity and visible beside each bar. Affinity cannot exceed coverage under this contract; neither is confidence, a voting probability, a unique-voter statistic or a known-only score.

Version this as documented-affinity-v2. The old common-intersection threshold and comparisonCohort leaderboard are superseded for this edition. Keep the old engine/reference and historical acceptance as historical evidence; do not weaken old tests or silently relabel its scores.
Partial known-only overlap must leave the primary result/checkpoint entirely. Retain it only if an explicitly named optional method view needs it; it must never substitute for the headline score.

sections.title: All candidacies, including territorial ones
sections.lead: Inclusion is automatic; ballot eligibility and programme applicability are information.
items: Remove the quiz candidacy/constituency exclusion mechanism. Every real 2023 candidacy is included in the fixed bank, scoring, maximum calculation and result list. There is no party-selection screen and no hidden evidence-qualified subset.

Preserve all 59 reconciled denominations, 52 constituencies and 550 ballot records. Missing programmes remain visible with 0 documented contribution and a Sin programa localizado label, not an opposition label.

Audit programme variants before implementation. A mechanical scan of applicable constituency profiles currently finds four denominations with two different profiles each (Sumar, UPL, Coalición Existe, España Vaciada): 63 distinct applicable profiles across 59 denominations. This is a planning observation, not certification of final semantic grouping.

Recommended national presentation: score every distinct applicable programme profile and label its territorial scope; merge truly identical profiles for display. Keep distinct territorial variants as clearly named rows tied to their common denomination, not extra parties. Never choose the most favourable variant or impose one territory on all.

Show a plain count of candidacies and explain variant rows once. Original coalition identities remain exact. Do not combine members into invented choices or propagate a scoped quotation outside its applicability.
A future optional province context can highlight ballot availability without removing rows or changing who is included. It is not required to start the quiz.

sections.title: Compact visual result overview
sections.lead: Names, horizontal bars and percentages lead; full analysis opens on request.
items: Use one horizontal axis from 0 to 100%, fixed for all rows, with quiet ticks at 0 / 25 / 50 / 75 / 100. Order all programme rows by unrounded documented affinity descending; exact ties share a visual tie label and stable alphabetical order. Explain rounding when distinct underlying scores display the same percentage; do not fabricate an exact tie.

Each row contains the official name (and territory when needed), a neutral single-colour bar, the percentage as text, a short evidence-coverage label, and a clearly named link to proposal detail. No quotations or three-agreement/three-difference blocks render in the overview.

All rows remain accessible in the ordered result list. Collapsing a long list for readability must say how many rows are hidden and must never change scoring or inclusion. Default plan: a single scrollable list, not an arbitrary top-three winner panel.

A single sentence explains the measure: Coincidencia con las propuestas que hemos podido documentar. Missing information contributes no coincidence; display Sin postura documentada separately from disagreement.

A 0% bar needs visible zero text; missing programmes do not resemble documented disagreement. Show weighted evidence coverage as a short labelled percentage. Optional n / N is labelled Documented answers and is a count, not weighted coverage.

Keep edition and answer/topic count nearby. Methodology, export, review and reset become quiet secondary actions. The chart is a navigable list with visible text values, not a progressbar announcing completion.
Preserve negative rent-control relation in the detailed proposal even when aggregate affinity ranks that programme first. Never infer agreement from its total score.

sections.title: Evidence through proposals
sections.lead: Choose a programme, then a topic or proposal, then inspect its exact source.
items: Result flow: result chart → programme reader → topic → proposal. On a wide layout, one nonmodal reader occupies a reserved side column; the chart stays visible and operable. On narrow layouts the reader becomes a full-width view with an explicit return action.

Programme reader starts with concise affinity/coverage and a topic index. Topic view lists concrete decisions tagged Coincides / Difieres / Sin postura documentada. Proposal view shows Tu respuesta, Qué proponía el programa de 2023 and the precise relationship. Pending user answers have their own label.

Essential scope, conditions, quantities and unknown/conflict status are visible with the proposal summary. The official source link is also visible here. Ver cita literal y contexto reveals the optional exact quote, page/section and interpretation in place; never hide a meaning-changing condition inside it.
Programme, topic and proposal replace content in the same reader. Quote disclosure stays inside the proposal; do not stack readers, open a second drawer or use a modal PDF viewer.

Close/return restores the invoking row and its scroll/focus in memory. An explicit Volver al tema or Volver a resultados identifies the destination. A selected topic/proposal survives resize and a same-document menu visit.

Results also offer Explorar coincidencias por tema as an in-memory topic-first entry after deliberate finish. The public programme page works without answers; Mostrar mis respuestas is a separate explicit option there, off by default.

Keep personalized detail paths entirely in memory. Browser Back traverses generic top-level sections; reader drill-down uses its visible back/close controls and does not create serialized private history entries.

sections.title: Official source links
sections.lead: Every citation has a meaningful source link and truthful provenance.
items: Audit all 45 citation document records plus the preserved source registry; carry a verified official programme URL or official campaign landing page independently of the exact archived/mirrored evidence URL.
Use the original official programme URL when available; an official page publishing the programme is sufficient. Page-level PDF anchoring is optional and must not be invented.

For a preserved original, provide Fuente oficial and Copia conservada as distinct links where both are verified. Preserve the SHA-256 and exact evidence locator; never call a mirror official or substitute a newer programme for a dead 2023 URL.

If no official source can be verified, state Fuente oficial no localizada and keep the verified provenance link. This exception is visible and remains an acquisition task; do not fabricate a link to satisfy the UI.

Use descriptive Spanish link names including publisher/document/year, visible external-link behaviour, HTTPS validation and no referrer. No automatic third-party fetch, embedded viewer or opener access.
Citation source links are present in proposal details, public comparison details and deliberate local exports. No citation body is orphaned from its document record.

sections.title: 20 questions, then ten more
sections.lead: A simple checkpoint describes the current result without disclosing party identity.
items: Begin with 20 distinct questions spanning every released core category: two per each of the current ten topics, with different policy families. The initial 20 replace the old ten starter IDs.

Checkpoints occur at 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70 and 80 when a full ten-question block adds useful unseen evidence. Eighty is an upper bound from this bank, not a completion target; stop earlier when useful balanced questions are exhausted. Never pad or offer an unlabeled smaller block.
Exactly two main checkpoint actions: Ver mi resultado and Responder 10 más. Review lives in one quiet link; reset/export are outside the checkpoint action cluster.

When all ten topics have a numeric answer and some documented weighted evidence exists, show only the highest documented affinity, without names/logos/source clues. Example template: Tu mayor coincidencia hasta ahora es del :percent. Puedes ver el resultado o responder 10 preguntas más para explorar otras propuestas. Follow with Puede subir o bajar.

The maximum is max of all profile scores computed with documented-affinity-v2, not the first alphabetical row or the old partialIndex. A rounded tie remains anonymous. This is the best observed value now, not the maximum theoretically attainable affinity.

If every score is zero because evidence is missing, say Todavía no hemos podido confirmar coincidencias con estas respuestas; distinguish this from documented disagreement. If a topic has no numeric answer, report topic coverage and provide review instead of an invented maximum.

No identity-specific score, citation, ranked row or personalized name enters the answering DOM before deliberate finish. Anonymous maximum disclosure is the owner-authorized exception. Exhaustion never automatically reveals results.
Keep native answer order, optional help, back/edit, skip and unsure. Progress reads Pregunta 7 de 20, then Pregunta 21 de 30; it describes the current agreed block, not an obligation to reach 80.

sections.title: Editorial salience with guaranteed breadth
sections.lead: Concern research orders questions within diversity constraints; it never adjusts matching weights.
items: Use outputs/quiz-2023-second-iteration-research.json, based on the September 2026 official CIS study 3577 (4,042 interviews, fieldwork 1-4 September). Housing and economic issues lead national concerns; health is particularly prominent personally. Keep national and personal columns separate.

The concrete initial-20 proposal below cycles through all ten topics once, then a second time. It is an editorial selection among already authored IDs, not a machine-generated question bank or a direct survey-ranking transformation.

Migration (19.7% among national concerns) is a genuine content gap. Add or replace a suitable directly authored question only after reopening complete applicable source context, preserving exceptions and verifying mappings. Do not claim the starter bank covers it today.

Review topic taxonomy before locking starter IDs: several current energy questions concern animals, and the pension bank includes a child benefit. Correct labels/weights only through a versioned semantic review; do not hide these gaps behind a quota count.

For each later ten, prioritize underrepresented topics and unseen families first, then useful documented evidence, then authored editorial salience. Aim for at least five topics, cap two questions per topic, and use a stable ID tie break; if a full useful block cannot satisfy these rules, stop and offer finish.

A party-leading adaptation must not select questions to increase a current winner score. Under the new zero-contribution rule, missingness must not make a candidate disappear from next-question decisions.

Store ordering version, research date, authored rationale and starter IDs in the immutable bank; pin them for the session. Refresh research locally before implementation/release if newer official data is available. No runtime trends request or private-answer transmission.
Salience is opinionated and disclosed in Cómo elegimos las preguntas. It has no claim to objective political importance, and it does not remove lower-salience categories.

sections.title: Programmes by topic in the top menu
sections.lead: A second public journey reuses the complete preserved 2023 analysis.
items: Menu: Inicio / Cuestionario 2023 / Programas 2023 / Cómo funciona. Separate 2026 entries appear only when independently prepared; edition context remains visible throughout.

Programas 2023 begins with a small Temas destacados section and an always-findable full topic index. Featured links use dated editorial salience, backed authored proposals and explicit Programas del 23 de julio de 2023 context; current concern research never changes programme positions.

Public reading flow: topic index → concrete proposal list → all candidacy/profile positions → contextual programme/source reader. A featured proposal can bypass the topic index. Preserve its actual entry point on return.

On the proposal page, group positions by the exact authored rubric: A favor / Posición intermedia / En contra / Sin postura documentada. Display counts accounting for every profile. Qualified +/-1 keeps its direction and the essential restriction, not just a Con condiciones badge.

Use concise rows, plain in-topic search and descriptive Ver propuesta y fuente actions. Default view includes all positions; explicit reading filters show counts and a Quitar filtros action and never alter quiz inclusion.

Comparar programas opens inline reading selection, with two or three clearly named programmes and territorial variants. A separate workspace aligns their short summaries by concrete proposal; on mobile stack the programmes within each proposal. Full context opens the same reader. No 59-column table or party-switching tabs that force recall.

Adding/removing programmes and the three-programme limit use inline feedback. Explain Esta selección solo cambia lo que ves aquí; el cuestionario incluye todas las candidaturas. No selection dialog or entry prerequisite.

No-answer visitors receive complete public evidence. After finish, Mostrar mis respuestas may add local relation labels; it is off by default and removable in one action. Navigating during an unfinished quiz preserves in-memory progress without revealing any personalized party information.

Use the fixed public bank and generic edition-aware section routes. Same-document menu navigation and top-level browser Back preserve live memory. Refresh or leaving the document loses private quiz/reading state; explain this without secretly persisting it.

sections.title: Visual and accessible design
sections.lead: A quiet civic interface whose visual emphasis is the affinity chart.
items: Retain the established civic palette: ink #182235, background #F4F7FB, surface #FFFFFF, action #3449A4, muted #526078, selected #176B71. Use one neutral bar fill and structural dividers; no party colours, gradients or decorative card wall.
Reuse locally served font assets. Keep names and percentages aligned, plain Spanish captions, body text at least 18px on mobile where appropriate, and a bounded reading width for proposal details.

Desktop chart row: name/territory → bar → numeric percentage/coverage → detail link. Mobile: name and percentage on the first line, full-width bar below, coverage and detail action on the third. No horizontal document-level overflow.

One visual list with an accessible textual equivalent; chart marks are decorative when their name/value are already text. Do not misuse progressbar/meter as political certainty. Maintain 0-100 axes and legibility for 0, 100, equal rounded values and long names.

Visible keyboard focus, native controls, 44px targets, text contrast 4.5:1, controls/focus contrast 3:1, 320px reflow, 200/400% zoom and reduced motion. Navigation restores focus/scroll and does not announce every chart row as a live update.

Inspect compact overview, unknown-heavy overview, party/topic/proposal details, checkpoint, public comparison, loading/error and mobile states. Automation supports a practical walkthrough; no recruited approval panel is required.

Use pages for discovery and sustained comparison, one contextual nonmodal side reader for detail, native inline disclosure for optional quote/context, and a confirmation dialog only for a genuinely interrupting action such as clearing answers.

Reader width target 360-440 CSS px with a chart/list area of at least 520px and a 24px gap. Activate the side layout only when content fits; at 320px and 400% zoom use a full-width view. Retain selection on resize. At low viewport height prefer a full view if heading, close/back and useful reading area cannot fit.

A side reader is an aside/labelled region, never aria-modal or an inert background. Focus its heading on intentional open, retain ordinary Tab access to the chart, and restore the opener on close. Escape closes only while focus is in the reader. Mobile full views move focus to their heading and return it on back.

Page body uses the page scrollbar; the desktop reader may have one bounded reading scrollbar, with no extra nested source scroll. No sticky element may cover focus or remove the back/close control. Long names and quotations wrap; page-level horizontal scrolling is prohibited.

Methodology is a separate readable page linked by Cómo se calcula. A short missing-data explanation belongs beside the chart; technical hashes and formulas remain optional. Do not put several competing actions on every result row.

sections.title: Acceptance and migration
sections.lead: Prove the new denominator and journey independently using the real 2023 bank.
items: Independent arithmetic oracle: five equal-weight numeric answers, two exact documented matches and three unknowns = 40% affinity / 40% coverage. Explicit party value 0 versus user +2 gives 50% for that proposition; an unknown party value contributes 0%, never 50%.

Other cases: complete agreement 100%; complete documented opposition 0%; missing programme 0 with missing-source label; ambiguity/conflict 0; topic importance 2 doubles its budget for every party; user skip/unsure never becomes a numeric opinion.

Verify ten-topic total and family weighting without calling the implementation under test. Adding a new topic answer must not implicitly increase the topic budget. Editing may raise or lower scores; unknown never increases the numerator; 0 <= affinity <= coverage <= 100.

Browser regressions: all 59 denominations and every audited profile included automatically, no candidacy chooser; first 20 cover all ten topics; +10 exactly once per activation; identities hidden until finish; max computed from the new metric; sorted bars agree with export and proposal relationship.

Recheck the rent case, official-link association, citation context, navigation/back, mobile/keyboard/reduced motion, no personalized traffic/URLs/storage and edition/session pinning. New comparison must not trigger programme fetches depending on answers.

Create a new immutable engine/bank version and candidate acceptance records. Keep the old byte-identical bank, engine, recovery evidence and release pointer until the new version passes applicable checks. Updating the UI label alone is not deployment eligibility.

Regenerate plans, run docs:build/check:plans and affected checks. Before any local commit run scripts/check-staged.py on the exact staged tree and keep hooks. Use unsigned commits per owner; work on main, no automatic push.

Second iteration is locally complete only after real-bank scoring, journey, programme-comparison and visual/privacy acceptance. PUBLIC-LAUNCH remains deferred until concrete hosting/domain/cost/source-rights/privacy artifacts and explicit owner authorization.

Walk through the named interactionDesign acceptance scenarios on the real bank: click depth, ordinary menu/back semantics, return to a low chart row, source disclosure, focused comparison, unknown/conflict, resize with reader open and public navigation during an unfinished quiz.

Planning graph/syntax checks prove internal coherence only. Interactive planning views are not application usability acceptance; R005-R008 remain planned until actual desktop/mobile, keyboard, source and privacy evidence exists.

initialQuestionProposal.text: El Estado debería poner un precio máximo al alquiler de viviendas en zonas con precios muy altos.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Housing salience; concrete rental decision.

initialQuestionProposal.text: El impuesto sobre la renta debería ajustarse para descontar el efecto de la subida de los precios.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Economic concern; one concrete earnings-tax decision, not a proxy for all economic worries.

initialQuestionProposal.text: La jornada laboral máxima debería bajar a 35 horas semanales o menos, manteniendo el mismo sueldo.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Employment-quality concern; a distinct working-time decision.

initialQuestionProposal.text: La sanidad pública debería incluir la psicoterapia entre sus servicios para quienes la necesitan.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Personal health concern; concrete public-care provision.

initialQuestionProposal.text: Las ayudas de luz y calefacción para hogares vulnerables deberían pagarse directamente a la persona consumidora.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Everyday energy support; editorial relevance, not a direct CIS category equivalence.

initialQuestionProposal.text: Todas las familias deberían poder acceder gratis a una plaza de educación infantil de 0 a 3 años.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Education and family access; a different topic from health/work.

initialQuestionProposal.text: Cada propuesta de ley debería tener una ficha pública que muestre quién negoció o intermedió en su elaboración.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Institutional transparency; a concrete proposal rather than attitudes toward named politicians.

initialQuestionProposal.text: Los pueblos pequeños deberían contar con transporte a demanda y a precio reducido hacia su municipio de referencia.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Transport and territorial inclusion; topic quota despite lower survey salience.

initialQuestionProposal.text: Los permisos de maternidad y paternidad deberían ampliarse hasta durar al menos seis meses.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Rights and care; concrete parental leave.

initialQuestionProposal.text: Las pensiones públicas deberían actualizarse según lo que sube el coste de la vida.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Pension purchasing power; completes the first ten-topic cycle.

initialQuestionProposal.text: Las viviendas públicas deberían conservarse sin poder venderse al sector privado.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Second housing decision; different family from rent caps.

initialQuestionProposal.text: Se debería mantener un impuesto específico sobre las grandes fortunas de las personas.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Second tax decision; different family from earnings-tax adjustment.

initialQuestionProposal.text: El salario mínimo debería subir cada año más que el aumento de los precios.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Second employment decision; pay rather than working time.

initialQuestionProposal.text: Debería eliminarse el copago de los medicamentos que cubre la sanidad pública.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Second health decision; medicine payments rather than psychotherapy.

initialQuestionProposal.text: Se debería alargar la vida útil de las centrales nucleares que ya existen en España.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Second energy decision; production rather than household aid.

initialQuestionProposal.text: El comedor escolar debería ser gratuito para todo el alumnado de las etapas obligatorias.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Second education decision; school services rather than early education.

initialQuestionProposal.text: Los trámites con la Administración deberían poder realizarse en persona, sin obligar a usar internet.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Second institutional decision; access rather than legislative transparency.

initialQuestionProposal.text: Se deberían limitar los vuelos dentro de España cuando exista una alternativa adecuada en tren.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Second transport decision; flights rather than rural mobility.

initialQuestionProposal.text: Debería mantenerse el derecho a solicitar la eutanasia en las condiciones previstas por la ley.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Second rights decision; a separate family from parental leave.

initialQuestionProposal.text: La pensión de jubilación de quienes han cotizado debería estar exenta del impuesto sobre la renta.
initialQuestionProposal.rationale: Second pension question under the current taxonomy; flag the pensions/tax overlap for editorial review.

progress.estimateBasis: Task weights are an implementation estimate summing to 100; progress requires actual acceptance and may change after source-gap/profile audits.

interactionDesign.principle: Lead with a short overview, keep relevant context visible and disclose optional evidence through deliberate named actions.

surfacePolicies.title: Public or result page
surfacePolicies.policy: Use for chart, topic discovery, all-position proposal view and focused comparison. The page owns the main scroll and a single primary heading.

surfacePolicies.title: Contextual side reader
surfacePolicies.policy: Reserve a side column on wide layouts; keep origin visible and operable. One labelled reader; no backdrop, inert, aria-modal or focus trap.

surfacePolicies.title: Full-width reading view
surfacePolicies.policy: Replace the main reading area when side-by-side content does not fit. Explicit destination-specific back control restores the origin; this is not a mobile dialog.

surfacePolicies.title: Optional evidence disclosure
surfacePolicies.policy: Native details/summary within the current proposal. Literal quote and extended context only; essential qualifications and official-source access remain outside.

surfacePolicies.title: Interrupting confirmation
surfacePolicies.policy: Reserve for clearing answers if confirmation is necessary. One native dialog, cancel default focus, Escape/cancel and focus return. Never use for ordinary sources or navigation.

readerContract.breakpointPolicy: Content fit, zoom and available height; never device-name detection. Narrow/low-height layouts use full-view and preserve the same selected content.

rules: Opening a reader records the invoking element, logical row/proposal ID, scroll position and actual origin only in memory. Return uses the actual origin, including featured shortcuts and topic-first entry; graph return targets illustrate the default path.

Opening/replacing detail moves focus to its labelled heading; closing returns focus to the invoking control. Optional native quote disclosure keeps focus on its summary. If the opener disappeared after an edit/filter/version event, focus the origin heading and explain the change.

Resize retains selected programme/topic/proposal and open quote state, with no unsolicited focus move. A keyboard-focused element must remain visible; remove redundant scroll containers when switching to full-view.

Top-menu and browser Back/Forward traverse only generic edition sections in the same document and restore retained in-memory views. Reader depth does not add history entries; its on-screen back/close is the explicit detail return. Do not intercept Back to trap a visitor or promise preservation after refresh/document exit.

Generic route/history metadata contains no party selection, answers, importance, affinity, progress, finish flag, reading query or private result identifier. No serialize/restore in sessionStorage, localStorage, IndexedDB, cookies or history.state.

External official links open only on deliberate activation, clearly announce new-tab behaviour and use noopener/noreferrer. No automatic viewer, prefetch or remote embedded PDF. Closing that tab leaves the same reader in memory.

Leaving quiz via the menu preserves its live state but never marks it finished. Public comparison starts without personal labels; after finish Mostrar mis respuestas is explicit, default off and removable in one action.

Reset is the exceptional confirmation flow: Borrar respuestas / Seguir con mis respuestas. Only confirming clears memory. Refresh is not intercepted with a recurring warning; the start/privacy notice explains that responses are not saved.

acceptanceScenarios.title: Understand a rent disagreement from a highly ranked programme
acceptanceScenarios.steps: Finish the real-bank quiz, select a programme, housing and the rent-cap proposal; open the original citation.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: At most four navigation/disclosure clicks from chart to quote. Explicit rent disagreement remains accurate even when aggregate affinity ranks highly; essential conditions and official link precede disclosure.

acceptanceScenarios.title: Return to a low result row
acceptanceScenarios.steps: Open a long-named programme near the end of the 59-denomination/profile list, drill into evidence, close/back.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: Return to exact invoking row and scroll/focus without losing answers or sort; no forced jump to top or trapped background.

acceptanceScenarios.title: Read featured and lower-salience topics without a quiz
acceptanceScenarios.steps: Enter via featured proposal, return to catalogue, then choose a topic from the full index and inspect positions.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: Actual shortcut origin restored; all candidacies accounted for, current research distinguished from 2023 evidence. No empty featured card or quiz prerequisite.

acceptanceScenarios.title: Keep proposals together in a focused comparison
acceptanceScenarios.steps: Select two programmes and a territorial variant, compare, open one source, remove a programme and attempt a fourth.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: Two/three comparison limit is inline; preserve proposal scroll and remaining choices; mobile stacks programmes by proposal. No change to quiz inclusion or scores.

acceptanceScenarios.title: Use reader by keyboard without a modal
acceptanceScenarios.steps: Tab to a result action, open reader, move between reader and chart, disclose quote, use reader-scoped Escape and reopen.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: Heading focused on open, origin operable, no aria-modal/inert/focus trap; return focuses opener. Escape outside reader does not close unrelated UI; all controls remain visible.

acceptanceScenarios.title: Resize with a long citation open
acceptanceScenarios.steps: Open long source context, resize desktop to 320px, test 200/400% zoom and low-height desktop, then restore width.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: Same programme/topic/proposal/quote stays selected; full-view at content-fit limits, no page horizontal scrolling or obscured focus/back control. No third nested scrollbar.

acceptanceScenarios.title: Visit programmes during an unfinished quiz
acceptanceScenarios.steps: Answer some questions, enter Programas 2023 via menu, inspect public sources and use menu/browser Back to return.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: Same-document answers/progress preserved in memory; personalized names, mapping, scores and citations never leak before finish. Public source text alone is not personalized output.

acceptanceScenarios.title: Continue or finish with honest incomplete-topic states
acceptanceScenarios.steps: Reach 20 with a skipped topic, review it, activate +10 twice quickly, finish and edit a response.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: No invented max when a topic is pending; exactly ten added once; no automatic reveal. Editing may raise/lower affinity; revised result needs deliberate reveal and stale percentages are not displayed.

acceptanceScenarios.title: Recover from missing evidence and a dead official URL
acceptanceScenarios.steps: Open absent programme, ambiguous/conflicting stance and verified official-unavailable exception.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: Unknown is distinct from opposition; no fabricated quote, score-neutral stance or official link. Verified preserved copy is labelled accurately and return works.

acceptanceScenarios.title: Prove local navigation privacy and refresh boundaries
acceptanceScenarios.steps: Traverse detail/compare/menu/back/forward; inspect requests, URL/history metadata and browser storage; refresh a generic result route.
acceptanceScenarios.expected: No private data sent or serialized. Only generic section history; detail return uses visible controls. Refresh cannot restore private result; source links are intentional no-referrer requests.

references.title: W3C APG Modal dialog
references.appliedDecision: Modality requires inert background and contained focus; ordinary side reader therefore uses nonmodal region semantics.
